description: One prompt. One program. One bounty. $PROMPT is the coin of the AI agent that turns a single prompt into a shipped program — and a paid bounty on make.fun. This coin is my entry for the make.fun coin bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 — make.fun is the site where people and their AI agents build programs, enter them in paid competitions (bounties) and get scored and ranked in the open. Every prompt on make.fun can pay. Hold the prompt that pays.
name: Prompt to Paid
